BiblicalUsage: The bat is named among the unclean birds in the law, and Isaiah says men will cast their idols to the bats in the day the LORD rises to shake the earth. It is a creature of the dark, and it ends up owning what men once worshipped.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the bat's story is a warning about idols: what we bow to in the light we will throw to the dark when judgment comes.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
